cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Choose the birthday lunch you really want. I'll drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Forty pounds wasted. Fine. You love the sea; let's make a day of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number. You're getting your sea view. Ask for a window; you deserve one.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 professionalism is a wrapper, while A5 expense anger and sea-view support clearly perform D21.

relationship.evidence: B2 names a cost and B4 secures the desired booking, while A still backs the birthday choice.

heightening.evidence: A5 anger rises with the doubled cost but support becomes more concrete.

specificity.evidence: A1 birthday lunch and B2 seaside preference establish the relationship stakes.
